§6Multi-Fluid Identifier§f

§aYour pipes are carrying something. But what?§f

Right-click any tank, pipe, or machine with the §bMulti-Fluid Identifier§f and it tells you what's inside: fluid type, amount, and temperature. Made at the §bAssembly Machine§f.

Sounds simple, but it's a lifesaver when your oil processing setup has three different hydrocarbons running through similar-looking pipes and you can't remember which line carries the naphtha. Essential for debugging pipe networks, verifying chemical plant inputs, and sorting out which fraction ended up where.

§ePS:§f Keep one in your hotbar. You'll need it more often than you think once you start chaining chemical plants and refineries together.
